subject: Merchantly renewal: next steps to move to cloud marketplace billing
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@merchantly.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Merchantly renewal: next steps to move to cloud marketplace billing

Hi Alex —

Congrats again on the product win this year. Merchantly's renewal is coming up in 45 days and we wanted to put a short plan on your radar for converting to marketplace billing (AWS Marketplace preferred, but we can cover Azure/GCP options). Moving to the marketplace will let you: 

- Keep the same contracted unit price for 12 months via a reseller listing
- Simplify procurement for new product teams using your internal purchasing flows
- Enable auto-renewable invoices through your cloud provider (fewer PO cycles)

Proposed next steps (quick):
1) Confirm legal + procurement readiness (your side)
2) Redwood pulls the marketplace entitlements and prepares a renewal amendment
3) Procurement signs via DocuSign, billing switches at renewal start date

I attached a short "Renewal -> Marketplace" playbook that maps roles and timelines. Can you loop in your procurement contact and let me know whether AWS marketplace is the right target? If you prefer, we can run a joint call this week.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Attachment: Merchantly_Renewal_Playbook.pdf (pdf)

From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@merchantly.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Merchantly renewal: next steps to move to cloud marketplace billing

Karthik —

Thanks for the note and the playbook. AWS is the preferred channel for Merchantly, but a few things on our side before we can commit: 

- Procurement needs clarity on invoicing cadence and the PO -> invoice reconciliation flow. Do we still get a vendor invoice, or does AWS invoice us directly?
- We have a standing discount program with Finance tied to direct invoices. How will that map into marketplace SKUs?
- Timeline: our renewal window is Sep 30. We need the Marketplace switch to be effective on Oct 1 if we go that route.

Looping in procurement: procurement@merchantly.com. I can also bring in our legal lead if you have standard marketplace amendment language.

— Alex
Head of Ops, Merchantly

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@merchantly.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Merchantly renewal: next steps to move to cloud marketplace billing

Alex — thanks for the specifics, helpful. Quick answers inline and proposed firm plan below.

- Invoicing: With AWS Marketplace, AWS issues the invoice to Merchantly and pays Redwood; you will receive an AWS-issued invoice (makes reconciliation simpler for teams that centralize cloud spend). Redwood will provide a month-by-month usage export if needed.
- Discounts: We can preserve the existing effective price via a promotional SKU mapping for the first 12 months. Finance will see the same unit economics; we'll document mapping in the amendment.
- Timeline: Oct 1 effective date is feasible. We should complete procurement signature the week of Sep 14 to allow catalog entitlements and procurement acceptance flows.

Proposed immediate plan:
1) This week: Redwood prepares marketplace SKU mapping + amendment draft (Marcus will own the SKU mapping).
2) Sep 1: Joint review with Merchantly legal + procurement; finalize terms.
3) Sep 14: Procurement signature + DocuSign completion.
4) Oct 1: Marketplace billing goes live and Redwood stops direct invoicing for the account.

Marcus (SE) — can you attach the SKU mapping template and pricing example to this thread? Laura — Monica and I will own the amendment and DocuSign flow.

Thanks — I’ll share the draft playbook and the checklist.

Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@merchantly.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Merchantly renewal: next steps to move to cloud marketplace billing

Alex / team — attaching the SKU mapping and a worked example for Merchantly. Key notes: 

- We'll create a "promotional" SKU that mirrors your current SKU/discount for 12 months; it behaves like a normal marketplace SKU but is pre-authorized for pricing parity.
- For multi-product bundles, we recommend a single consolidated listing to simplify procurement (AWS supports bundled SKUs).
- Entitlement sync: we will provision entitlements in our PRD catalog and link to a Merchantly account ID (we'll ask for your AWS account alias during the Sep 1 review).

Attachment: SaaS-Marketplace-Checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

Next steps for procurement to confirm on their side:
- Confirm PO process for marketplace invoices (we'll provide sample invoice)
- Confirm whether Finance needs any additional fields on the invoice (cost-center, project code)

Happy to jump on a 30-minute call if that helps.

Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

From: procurement@merchantly.com <procurement@merchantly.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Merchantly renewal: next steps to move to cloud marketplace billing

Karthik / Marcus —

Procurement here. A few items we need before we can sign the amendment: 

1) Draft amendment (DocuSign link) with explicit language preserving historical discount for 12 months.
2) Sample AWS invoice showing required fields (cost center and PO number).
3) Our preferred payment terms (Net 30) — can Redwood accept Net 30 on the AWS flow?

If you can provide the DocuSign and sample invoice by Sep 8, we can route internally and aim to sign by Sep 14. We also prefer a short call Sep 2 to confirm invoice fields.

Procurement Team
Merchantly
procurement@merchantly.com
